definitions.gloss: perfectionist tendency; obsessive temperament; fastidious nature
definitions.explanation: A personality trait of becoming deeply absorbed in something and pursuing it to a meticulous degree. Can describe the trait itself or a person who has it.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{凝|こ}り{性|しょう}だから{何|なん}でも{徹底的|てっていてき}にやる。
examples.english: He has a perfectionist streak, so he does everything thoroughly.

examples.japanese: {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}なので、{料理|りょうり}を{始|はじ}めたら{道具|どうぐ}もスパイスも{全部|ぜんぶ}{揃|そろ}えてしまう。
examples.english: Because of my perfectionist nature, once I start cooking, I end up buying all the tools and spices.

examples.japanese: {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}なところがあって、{趣味|しゅみ}を{始|はじ}めるとお{金|かね}も{時間|じかん}もかけすぎてしまう。
examples.english: I have a tendency to get obsessive, so when I start a hobby, I end up spending too much money and time on it.

notes:
USAGE:
{凝|こ}り{性|しょう} comes from {凝|こ}る (to be devoted to, to be particular about) + {性|しょう} (nature, temperament). It is usually used positively or neutrally, suggesting dedication rather than unhealthy obsession.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}な{人|ひと} (a person with perfectionist tendencies)
- {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}なところがある (to have a perfectionist streak)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}: gets deeply into things (personality trait)
- こだわり{屋|や}: picky, particular about details
- {完璧主義|かんぺきしゅぎ}: perfectionism (stronger, can be negative)
